idea-plugin.name: LaTeX Submission Lint: Desk-Reject Check
idea-plugin.description:
Seventeen rules on your .tex file: the statements the editorial office looks for, and the source that breaks the publisher's build.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → LaTeX Submission Lint: Desk-Reject Check: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 17 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/latex-submission-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/latex-submission-lint
